class UnionFind(object):  # Time: O(n * α(n)), Space: O(n)
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.set = range(n)
        self.rank = [0]*n

    def find_set(self, x):
        stk = []
        while self.set[x] != x:  # path compression
            stk.append(x)
            x = self.set[x]
        while stk:
            self.set[stk.pop()] = x
        return x

    def union_set(self, x, y):
        x_root, y_root = map(self.find_set, (x, y))
        if x_root == y_root:
            return False
        if self.rank[x_root] < self.rank[y_root]:  # union by rank
            self.set[x_root] = y_root
        elif self.rank[x_root] > self.rank[y_root]:
            self.set[y_root] = x_root
        else:
            self.set[y_root] = x_root
            self.rank[x_root] += 1
        return True

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.set = range(n)
        self.rank = [0]*n

    def find_set(self, x):
        stk = []
        while self.set[x] != x:  # path compression
            stk.append(x)
            x = self.set[x]
        while stk:
            self.set[stk.pop()] = x

        x, y = self.find_set(x), self.find_set(y)

            x, y = y, x

        if self.rank[x] == self.rank[y]:

        return True

        dp = [0] * (target+1)
        for i in xrange(1, target+1):

            # case 3. drive less then 2^k-1, and turn back some distance,
            #         and turn back again to make the direction is the same
            #         seq(i) = shortest(seq(i), A^(k-1) -> R -> A^j -> R ->
            #                                   seq(i - (2^(k-1)-1) + (2^j-1)),
            #                  where 0 <= j < k-1)
            #         => dp[i] = min(dp[i], (k-1) + 1 + j + 1 +
            #                               dp[i - (2**(k-1)-1) + (2**j-1)])
            for j in xrange(k-1):

                    self.update(ql, qr, v, m, r, 2*i+1)
                if self.cnt[i] > 0:

                else:

                        self.tree[i] = 0
                    else:
                        self.tree[i] = self.tree[2*i]+self.tree[2*i+1]

        x_to_idx = {x:i for i, x in enumerate(sorted_x)}
